meta.title: BBA (Hons.) in Finance in Mumbai– ATLAS ISME
meta.description: Interested in business psychology? Learn consumer behavior, decision science and career skills. Apply now.

panes.label: Overview
panes.text:
The BBA (Hons.) in Finance at ATLAS ISME is crafted to develop ambitious, future-ready finance professionals capable of excelling in a fast-paced, data-driven global economy. The program lays a solid foundation in financial strategy, risk management and financial innovation.

You will engage in practical learning through live market simulations, industry case studies, finance labs, and masterclasses delivered by expert practitioners. From investment analysis to fintech disruption, every concept is taught with a focus on real-world business applications. By the end of the program, you will be equipped to make data-driven decisions, foster financial growth and generate business impact whether working with a multinational corporation, a cutting-edge startup or your own entrepreneurial venture.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: These courses build skills in leadership, strategy, consumer behavior, finance, design thinking, entrepreneurship, and data-driven decision-making using AI and Excel.

courses.title: Principles of Management
courses.text: Master the art of making big-picture decisions. Learn how to evaluate competition, allocate resources, and plan for long-term business success in volatile environments.

courses.title: Marketing Management & Consumer Behaviour
courses.text: Understand what drives consumer choices and how to design strategies that resonate. Explore branding, segmentation, and the psychology behind purchasing decisions.

courses.title: Basics of Finance / Design Thinking for Businesses
courses.text: Gain a solid grounding in financial principles and business valuation, or learn to apply creative problem-solving through design thinking to real-world challenges.

courses.title: Entrepreneurship Fundamentals
courses.text: Build the mindset and tools to turn ideas into ventures. Learn about business models, innovation, and strategies for sustainable growth.

courses.title: Indian Behavioural Psychology
courses.text: Explore behavioural patterns rooted in Indian culture and society. Understand how values, emotions, and context influence decision-making.

courses.title: AI Tools and Excel for Decision Making
courses.text: Master modern analytical tools to make data-driven business decisions. Learn to use AI and Excel for smarter insights and efficiency.

courses.title: ATLAS Elective
courses.text: Gain a clear understanding of how money flows within businesses. Learn the essentials of financial statements, budgeting, and valuation to make informed business decisions with confidence.

semesters.text: These courses focus on modern business skills, from innovative business models and digital marketing to financial analysis and systems thinking. Students also learn economics, professional communication, data-driven decision-making and problem-solving.

courses.title: New-age Business Models

courses.title: Digital Marketing
courses.text: Understand the strategies behind online branding, advertising, and analytics. Learn to craft impactful digital campaigns across platforms.

courses.title: Financial Statement Analysis / Systems Thinking for Innovation
courses.text: Analyze financial reports to assess business performance and value, or develop holistic problem-solving skills using systems thinking to drive innovation.

courses.title: Economics
courses.text: Gain a clear understanding of how markets function. Learn to analyze economic trends, consumer behavior, and policy impacts on business decisions.

courses.title: Business Communication
courses.text: Develop professional communication skills for the modern workplace. Learn how to write, present, and collaborate effectively across teams.

courses.title: Statistics for Business / Creative Thinking & Problem Solving
courses.text: Use statistical tools to interpret data and make sound business decisions, or enhance your creativity and problem-solving mindset through structured innovation techniques.

courses.title: ATLAS Elective / Social Project
courses.text: Gain real-world experience by applying classroom concepts in a professional setting. Build skills, confidence, and industry exposure.

courses.title: Orientation of Indian Constitution
courses.text: Understand the foundational principles of the Indian Constitution. Learn how its values shape governance, citizenship, and business ethics.

semesters.text: These courses cover investment, finance, marketing, research, sustainability, internships, and multidisciplinary learning for well-rounded business skills.

courses.text: Master the essentials of corporate finance—budgeting, cash flow, and strategic planning to support sound business decisions

courses.text: Discover how Customer Relationship Management (CRM) drives marketing success. Learn to leverage data for personalized strategies and stronger customer engagement.

courses.title: Marketing Strategy
